meta.title: Optimize interpreter ops
meta.body_summary: Centralize built-in operator implementations in a shared table and route applyBinaryValue / applyUnaryValue through it to optimize interpreter dispatch; tests fail with golden mismatch.

perf_labels.notes: Author self-closed PR 6 minutes after creation with only a narrative description; tests failed with golden mismatch and no performance evidence was provided.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: 256 changed lines, a small-to-medium refactor by absolute volume, centralizing op implementations in a new file. As a performance PR it was closed due to test failure and lack of performance evidence.

review_details.concern_detail: The PR body explicitly notes that `go test ./...` fails with 'golden mismatch', suggesting the change in interpreter behavior broke expected output.
review_details.performance_claim: Centralize built-in operator implementations to improve interpreter dispatch performance.
review_details.rejection_signals: Author self-closed PR 6 minutes after creation; test failure and absence of performance evidence drove closure.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The agent produced an interpreter refactor that broke existing tests (golden mismatch), indicating a boundary in understanding the interpreter's expected behavior; no maintainer review required to surface the issue.

detection_detail.code_reading: No maintainer detection recorded; author discovered test failure.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiling data; only narrative claim of centralization. Test failure may be reproducible but does not constitute performance evidence.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without any fix; no subsequent commits.

core_change_summary.description: Added interpreter/op_table.go with a centralized table mapping operator kinds to specific operation handles, and modified interpreter/runtime_utils.go to route applyBinaryValue and applyUnaryValue calls through the new table, removing inline dispatch.
change_trajectory: Single commit added op_table.go (233 lines) and modified runtime_utils.go (6 additions, 17 deletions) to implement centralized op dispatch.

collaboration_trajectory: PR created by OpenAI_Codex with one commit; author self-closed within 6 minutes of creation; no review or collaboration.
